name: Gender Dysphoria
detailed_description:
Gender Dysphoria is a psychological/body horror experience that offers insight into my personal struggle of growing up with it in daily life. You must navigate these memories, experiencing the fear, confusion, and isolation of being trapped in a body that feels alien to you. But you are not alone a mysterious girl accompanies you. Who is she? The answers await as you journey with her.

Features:

  • Survive the Internal Struggles
    Experience dysphoria through my eyes. Avoid threats by running and hiding.

  • Sound Is Your Only Warning
    Your survival depends on listening to your surroundings.

  • Uncover and Understand Gender Dysphoria
    Explore memories that reveal a deeper understanding of the impact of gender dysphoria as a person struggles to find themselves and navigate life.
